releases.headline: Initial release of the HermitStash sync client
releases.summary: First public cut of the PQC-encrypted desktop file sync daemon for HermitStash. Twenty source files, around 2,600 lines, and zero npm runtime dependencies.

items.title: WebSocket sync transport over post-quantum TLS
items.body: Connects to the server's `/sync/ws` endpoint using a TLS 1.3 handshake negotiated against the `X25519MLKEM768` hybrid group, so the key exchange resists store-now-decrypt-later attacks.

items.title: SHA3-512 content hashing
items.body: Local file checksums use SHA3-512 to match the server's `checksum` field byte-for-byte, enabling drift detection and deduplication without re-uploading unchanged files.

items.title: File upload and download via the HermitStash HTTP API
items.body: Pushes new and changed files through the existing multipart upload route and pulls remote-only files through the streaming download route, reusing the server's existing auth and quota paths.

items.title: Local state database backed by `node:sqlite`
items.body: Persists per-file metadata, sequence cursor, and pending operations in a SQLite database under the user's data directory so the daemon can resume cleanly across restarts.

items.title: Filesystem watcher with debounce and ignore globs
items.body: Uses `fs.watch` with a coalescing debounce window and configurable ignore patterns so rapid editor save bursts collapse into a single sync event.

items.title: OS keychain storage for the API key
items.body: Stores the API key in the platform keychain (macOS Keychain, Linux `secret-tool`, Windows Credential Manager) instead of a plaintext config file.

items.title: Daemon mode with PID file and signal handling
items.body: Runs detached with a PID file for liveness checks and traps `SIGTERM`/`SIGHUP` for graceful shutdown and config reload.

items.title: Reconnect loop with exponential backoff
items.body: On WebSocket drops the client backs off from 1 second up to a 5 minute ceiling, preventing reconnect storms against the server while staying responsive on transient blips.

items.title: Initial sync plus catch-up via `seq` cursor
items.body: Bootstraps a new bundle by walking the full file list, then on every later connect replays missed changes from the last acknowledged sequence number forward.

items.title: Single-binary distribution via Node.js SEA
items.body: Ships as a Node.js Single Executable Application so operators install one signed binary per platform with no separate runtime install required.

items.title: Requires HermitStash server v1.3.0 or newer
items.body: The sync bundle type, `/sync/ws` endpoint, and `seq`-cursor catch-up flow this client depends on land in server v1.3.0; older servers will reject the WebSocket upgrade.
